meta.title: XJTLU Masters 2027 Korea - Full-time Programme Master Data
meta.audience: South Korean international applicants who need a Chinese student visa/residence permit for study

excluded_programmes.name: International MBA
excluded_programmes.reason: Current official directory lists it as part-time only. XJTLU states international students should generally apply to full-time study because of visa requirements.

degree_award.note: Successful completion leads to a University of Liverpool master's degree recognised by China's Ministry of Education. Do not describe XJTLU master's study as an XJTLU + Liverpool dual degree.

general_entry_requirement.official_xjtlu_minimum: UK upper second class honours (2:1) or equivalent

korea_gpa_guidance.status: TNS editorial guidance, not an XJTLU-published Korea GPA cutoff
korea_gpa_guidance.public_short_copy: 한국 대학 GPA 3.0/4.5 이상이면 우선 지원 가능성을 확인해 보세요.
korea_gpa_guidance.basis: XJTLU does not publish a Korea-specific GPA conversion table. University of Liverpool's South Korea guidance lists GPA 3.0/4.5 (or 2.8/4.3) as its general master's academic requirement; XJTLU still assesses programme fit and the individual application.

bands.guidance: 학업성적 측면에서는 비교적 여유 있게 검토할 수 있는 구간. 합격 보장은 아님.
지원 검토 가능 구간. 출신대학, 전공 적합성, 관련 과목 성적과 지원 과정에 따라 판단.
일반 참고선보다 낮은 구간. 관련 경력·전공 적합성·추가 강점이 있는 경우 개별 검토.

english_2027.test_date_rule: For 2027 entry, accepted English tests should be taken no earlier than 1 January 2025.
english_2027.note: Programme-level IELTS requirements are stored per programme.

application_deadlines_2027.february_intake_application: 2026-11-15 17:00 Beijing time (only programmes offering February entry)

scholarships.entry_scholarship_full_time: 20%, 30% or 50% of total programme tuition fee based on academic merit
scholarships.mres_full_scholarship: A small number of outstanding MRes applicants may be considered for a full tuition waiver
scholarships.alumni_discount: 20% for XJTLU, University of Liverpool or Xi'an Jiaotong University graduates; not cumulative with XJTLU entry scholarship

tuition.rule: Do not present 2026 programme fees as confirmed 2027 fees. Keep 2026 as reference until XJTLU publishes 2027 figures.
